'''Naris-bud [[Tea/Legends|tea]]''' was a drink enjoyed by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].

It is also one of the beverages served in the [[Jedi Temple refectory/Legends|Jedi Temple Refectory]].
